endpoint_directions.definition: Parameterwise displacements from the identical incumbent. Cosine is dot(u,v)/(norm(u)*norm(v)) and undefined for a zero displacement. Layer keys combine associated weight and bias in lexical order. Component dot products and norms are separately reconciled against concatenated vectors.
endpoint_directions.dtype: FP64 arithmetic on FP32 CPU tensors

method: Paired direct greedy actions on 40 fixed archived training positions, 10 games, 20 ordinary and 20 danger. Danger means at most 512 remaining recorded placements. The first number in each comparison is training seed 611000 update and the second is seed 612000 update. Exact untruncated legal CROSS origin counts after the selected move, including clears. Equal action indices check both archived move identity and counts. Repeated positions, retrospective strata and only two training seeds constrain generalization.

plan.actions: 40 exact archival rows, ten seeds, stable argmax on FP32 1x128 CPU per-row; top-1 minus top-2 logit margin; all/danger/ordinary; reuse the conventional observer
plan.formula: candidate.1.weight and candidate.1.bias = (incumbent FP32 + plain update-80 FP32) * 0.5 in PyTorch, all other tensors bitwise equal to update 80

gameplay.cap_censor: alive at 1024; capped values are lower bounds, capped differences marked explicitly
gameplay.selection: greedy, unadjusted actor, standard physical commit and targets; copy original piece state at immutable roots

plan.scope: Retrospective fit-side diagnostic. Variant was motivated by the existing decision fixture. No tuning, fresh evaluation, training or model promotion.

historical.reference: same checkpoint, teacher, torch, GPU and width 32; previous runtime, historical 64k cap, nobody reached it

modelled_gpu_budget.model: For active widths 1–8 use observed incumbent inter-terminal wall time per lockstep. Fit a linear increment above width 8 to the earlier 72-game aggregate while replaying only historical lengths, using the shipped FIFO replacement rule. Resample these lengths 500 times with replacement (seed 51). Conditional draw spread excludes session/hardware/player drift. Times for preview = greedy time at those lengths + additive effective CPU/transfer milliseconds per placement. Scenarios assume uncapped completion of all eight PPO arms, no screen cache savings, three distinct qualifying players, and one chosen finalist paired versus incumbent if qualification selects a challenger.

pilot_common_to_both.scope: Predictions on fixed pre-action archived boards. Labels are the original incumbent rank-0 greedy continuations on each exact historical stream. Current-policy returns were not collected. Terminal errors are exact and cap cases only give lower bounds. Equal weight per root.

scope: Two matched plain PPO seeds, 40 archived boards and six separate hazard-conditioned natural continuations. The timing forecast is conditional on current workloads. Official evaluation starts from empty boards.
